known_limitations: Gitee remains fallback-only and is not counted as live or growth data
History growth requires natural time; missing baselines show as accumulating
Package metrics are ecosystem-specific and not directly cross-ranked
Gateway cache is memory-only and clears on server restart
Authenticated GitHub mode is optional and was not live-acceptance tested
Trust signals are public risk signals, not certification or legal conclusions
Upstream availability varies by network; proxy configuration may be needed
Early provenance history contains the user's local desktop path and is generalized in current docs
No real UI screenshots are committed yet
required_user_decisions: Approve repository owner and oss-reuse-radar slug
Approve public exposure of the early provenance desktop path or authorize a later history rewrite
Choose security contact: GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting (recommended) or an approved public email
